Backend: 14/14 NEW V1.1 bilingual pytest cases PASS in 83s + 44/44 V1-α/V1-β/GAL regression PASS in 34s = 58/58 green. Frontend (1280x900): /kids/about renders KidsLandingPage hero+how-it-works+lang switcher; /kids/for-parents renders comparison table (8 rows) + Why-Us; EN→ID toggle instantly retranslates H1 same-tab ('Show your kid how the AI thinks.' → 'Tunjukkan ke anakmu cara AI berpikir.'); lang persists across reload; lang persists across navigation (about → for-parents stays ID); lang switcher present on /kids/login + /kids/signup + /kids/awaiting-consent + /kids/parental-consent/{token}; signup form fully Indonesian when lang=id ('Mulai investasi dengan AI', 'Nama kamu', 'Kata sandi', 'Tanggal lahir', 'Email orang tua', 'Daftar · Dapat 10.000 SC'); awaiting-consent fully Indonesian ('Hampir selesai!', 3-step explainer); parental-consent invalid-token error in Indonesian ('Link ini tidak bisa digunakan'); KidsShell authenticated nav has EN/ID toggle next to Logout; trade journal modal in Indonesian ('JURNAL TRANSAKSI', 'Pembelian bagus! Beri tahu dirimu nanti kenapa.', 'Kenapa kamu pikir saham ini akan naik?', '+50 StockCoins dan otak investor yang lebih tajam.'). Code review verified: App.js RootRedirect at lines 75-84 detects window.location.hostname === 'kidstocks.net' or '.kidstocks.net' suffix and Navigates to /kids/about replace; /kids/about + /kids/for-parents routes wired at lines 113-114. Live DNS test deferred (no kidstocks.net DNS yet) — code path verified by inspection per request. No mocks.

critical_code_review_comments: kids_preview.py line 126-127: language coercion `if lang not in ('en','id'): lang = 'en'` is duplicative with the typed Query default; consider promoting to a Pydantic-validated query param Literal['en','id'] for stricter 422-on-invalid behaviour. Current behaviour (silent coercion) matches request spec but masks client bugs.

kids_auth.py line 68: `lang: str = Field(default='en', pattern=r'^(en|id)$')` is correct; just note the contrast with /preview's silent coercion. Inconsistency is intentional per spec but worth a code comment.

GAL Indonesian first-call latency 15-25s is acceptable but consider warming the memo for AAPL/MSFT/NVDA/TSLA/BBCA.JK in both langs at deploy time so the first kid hitting /kids/about → preview doesn't eat a 25s cold start.

App.js RootRedirect: hostname check uses exact match plus `.kidstocks.net` suffix — covers www.kidstocks.net, app.kidstocks.net etc. Doesn't redirect on staging hosts (correct). No SSR concerns since CRA is client-side.

Frontend useKidsLang CustomEvent 'kids-lang-change' fires on same-tab toggle so siblings re-render — verified working. Cross-tab via storage event is also wired (per file ref) but I did not test multi-tab explicitly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: V1.1 fully green. Re-run full suite: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_stockkids_v1alpha.py tests/test_stockkids_v1beta.py tests/test_gal.py tests/test_stockkids_v11_bilingual.py -v (58 tests, ~120s with cold GAL on first ID call). The bilingual tests use pymongo (sync) directly; consent_token field name is 'consent_token' not 'token' (db.kids_consents schema). Email lowercasing matters: kid_email is stored .lower()+.strip(). The kidstocks.net hostname-redirect was NOT live-tested (no DNS); code inspection in App.js lines 75-84 confirms `host === 'kidstocks.net' || host.endsWith('.kidstocks.net')` triggers Navigate to /kids/about. Indonesian regex marker list in test (\b(yang|bilang|tunggu|kamu|sinyal|saham|...)\b) is broad enough that a future GAL prompt change won't break it unless model switches language entirely.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no product defects. Three test-script bugs caught and fixed during dev: (1) `_looks_indonesian` crashed on list-typed `did_you_know` field → coerce list→str before regex; (2) DB queries used un-lowercased email but backend stores .lower() → fixed; (3) consent doc field name is `consent_token` not `token` → corrected. All product behaviour matches spec.
